//strategy: round-robin | least-used | reset-soon. reset-soon ranks eligible accounts by soonest 7-day reset (drain-before-refill), tie-broken by least-used then slot number; an account closer than 10 percentage points to rateLimitPct on EITHER window is unranked and used only as a last resort (an account exactly 10 pp below the limit still ranks). That bounds how many sessions the funnel can strand, but does not prevent an overrun: a ranked account below the band is still the funnel target and can be driven past rateLimitPct, which aborts every resume pinned to it until the window resets. With nothing ranked it degenerates to least-used. Also governs session-less aux routing. JSON has no comments; this // key is ignored by the plugin.
//rotationButtons: Show per-account 'Take out of rotation' / 'Return to rotation' action-buttons in the panel. Like makePrimaryButtons, requires a host whose publishUI renderer includes action-button (shepherd#1209/#1210); kept a separate flag so the two features toggle independently. Set false on an older host to fall back to badge-only. JSON has no comments; this // key is ignored by the plugin.
//routeAuxQuota: DEFAULT true routes review/plan-gate/doc quota onto a pool account. REQUIRES a Shepherd release containing #1217 (NOT in v1.38.0 or earlier). On an older host you MUST set this to false or reviewers run UNAUTHENTICATED (re-login + theme prompt). JSON has no comments; this // key is ignored by the plugin.
//autoHeal: Enables auto-healing of accounts cswap transiently marks unavailable.
//autoHealAfterCycles: Consecutive refreshes an account must report usageStatus 'unavailable' before auto-heal attempts a revive (switch to it → launch one Claude session → switch back). Integer >= 1.
//healLaunchArgs: Claude args for the auto-heal launch, run as 'cswap run <target> -- <healLaunchArgs>'. Must start a real session that performs an API turn (refreshes OAuth) and exits on its own — '-p' headless one-shot. NOT prewarmArgs ('--version' does no API turn, heals nothing). Non-empty string array.
//healLaunchTimeoutMs: Timeout (ms) bounding the auto-heal launch; kills a hung session. Sized to a claude cold start + one -p turn + slack. Positive finite number.
